content:
Hello everyone! I am trying to import a custom puller but it seems that the slider is attached in a wrong place on the puller and I dont know how to fix it!

I just want it to be placed a bit further down. 

Any tips? Thank you so much for your help

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi, is this a registered zipper and puller or an OBJ? Are the puller and slider two separate parts? If they are registered as a custom zipper, you should be able to click on the puller twice (first selection selects both puller and slider, second the puller only) and adjust it with the gizmo.

title: CLO and Flow: The Art of Ruffles with Greta Staude
content:
## _Meet Greta Staude, a 3D Product Developer at Marc Cain, who is transforming fashion with her_[ _stunning Ruffle series_](https://www.instagram.com/p/DAyskryqWnP/) _! Join us as she shares her creative journey, inspiration, and the magic of using CLO to bring her designs to life. Get ready to be inspired!_  


* * *

**Please introduce yourself and share a bit about your background.**

My name is Greta Staude, I am 27 years old, and I come from Germany. I began my journey in the fashion industry by attending a fashion school, which laid the foundation for my passion. I then pursued a degree in Textile and Clothing Technology, where I was first introduced to CLO. Captivated by its potential, I dedicated every free moment to mastering the software through tutorials and hands-on practice. For the past 2.5 years, I have been working as a 3D Product Developer at Marc Cain, contributing to innovative digital workflows that are transforming the fashion industry.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/b1ccee79dcdc441d92e914a459fb36a0/images/56ed582cea2748ad972c5d3d4ad92da5image0.png)

**Your recent artworks feature flourish ruffles. Can you share the story or motivation behind their creation?**

I truly enjoy designing feminine garments adorned with flowing ruffles, as they bring a sense of elegance and movement to my work. My inspiration came from observing various forms in the wind—how they dance, behave, and fall gracefully. This dynamic motion deeply influenced my approach to creating intricate ruffle designs that feel both natural and expressive, allowing the wearer to experience a sense of freedom. I aimed to convey a sense of lightness and freedom through the Ruffle series, believing that the flowing, soft shapes and carefully chosen colors beautifully encapsulate this feeling.

**What specific techniques or methods did you use in CLO to create the ruffles in this series? Were there any unique challenges you faced during the design process?**

To create the ruffles, I utilized the ellipse pattern function. By carefully adjusting the shrinkage settings for both the weft and warp, I achieved my desired look without needing to make further alterations to the pattern piece. This precision allowed me to focus on the creative aspects of my design.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/b1ccee79dcdc441d92e914a459fb36a0/images/0cf279d90bf148a994341d2b90e14e5fimage%20-%202024-12-23T141838.870.png)

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/b1ccee79dcdc441d92e914a459fb36a0/images/c98d68abaa8a49689749160c3527d7d8image%20%28100%29.png)

**Can you describe your approach to planning and preparing for a new project? We’d love to hear about your usual routine.**

I typically start with a general idea of the vibe I want to convey or the emotions I aim to evoke. Instead of sketching, I dive straight into CLO with simple shapes, working to bring my vision to life directly in 3D. The beauty of working in CLO is the ability to immediately realize ideas, refine details, and see how everything comes together seamlessly, which keeps the creative process fluid and exciting.

**As you plan, how do you choose the materials for your Ruffle series? Do you have a particular fabric or texture in mind that enhances the flow and movement of the ruffles?**

From the very beginning, I knew I wanted to incorporate transparency into the ruffles to enhance the sense of lightness. The colors were chosen intuitively, guided by the emotions and inspirations I felt in the moment I created the shapes. This approach allows the materials to play a crucial role in the overall aesthetic.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/b1ccee79dcdc441d92e914a459fb36a0/images/a04ae790debe419baebb50e2c8aa1726MergedImages%20%281%29.png)

**What was your favorite part of creating these artworks using CLO?**

My favorite part was witnessing the ruffles come to life through simulation. Seeing how a simple circular pattern transforms into a stunning 3D shape with the right physical properties is truly magical. The moment I hit the simulate button and watch the design evolve from 2D to 3D is always exciting and rewarding, as it feels like my vision is materializing before my eyes.

**Which feature in CLO did you find most useful for creating these artworks?**

The most helpful feature was the ability to adjust materials and shapes in real-time, allowing me to see the results instantly. This immediate feedback is always fascinating. Additionally, CLO’s texture tools, especially the map generator, are incredibly useful for adding realistic details to my designs. I rely heavily on it for texturing my creations, as it enhances the overall visual impact.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/b1ccee79dcdc441d92e914a459fb36a0/images/74877c1b2cd94d3b86419081530d26c3Ruffle1.1.png)

**In terms of functionality, how does CLO enhance your ability to create the intricate ruffles in this series? Are there specific features that you find indispensable for achieving your vision?**

CLO significantly enhanced my ability to create these ruffles by providing powerful tools that streamline the design process. The ellipse pattern tool was particularly important, and the ability to experiment with various parameters in real-time allowed me to achieve the desired shape and flow, making the design process both efficient and enjoyable.

**How has your Ruffle series evolved since its inception? Are there any new ideas or directions you’re considering for future pieces?**

Since then, I have started incorporating ruffles into several of my works. My new Nike-inspired collection, which is generally very oversized and relaxed, features small ruffles as well. This addition adds a unique touch and makes the collection feel even more special. For my next project, I plan to experiment more with shapes, perhaps incorporating pleats and exploring pattern manipulation in general. I’m excited to see how these new elements will interact with my existing designs, so stay tuned to see what’s coming next!

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/b1ccee79dcdc441d92e914a459fb36a0/images/6196201a44744418ba21b596c7b44908imgonline-com-ua-twotoone-B3KlQqEWKOYG.png)

  
**What other software did you use for this artwork? Please provide details on how each software contributed to the final piece.**

In addition to CLO, I used Blender to create an environment and render the final animation. Blender allowed me to add depth and context to my designs, enhancing the overall presentation and making the ruffles stand out even more.

**What tips would you share with aspiring digital fashion designers who wish to follow a path like yours?**

My advice to beginners using CLO is to simply get started and not overthink it. The learning curve might feel a bit steep at first, but with consistent practice, you’ll be amazed at how quickly you pick it up. Don’t be afraid to make mistakes—that’s all part of the learning process. Remember, every project you work on will teach you something new. Most importantly, don’t give up! CLO is such a fun and rewarding tool, and as you progress, you’ll see how much it opens up your creativity. Enjoy the journey!  
  


![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/b1ccee79dcdc441d92e914a459fb36a0/images/d21550bb806d4193bb57081bc37ebc35greta_thumbnail.png)
content_description: Discover how Greta Staude harnesses CLO’s cutting-edge 3D design tools to create her elegant, flowing Ruffle series and transform fashion through innovative digital craftsmanship.

title: Hello (안녕하세요) . Request Seamline intensity, Thickness normal map( 심라인을 강조하기 위한 노말맵 jpg를 요구합니다.)
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202502/437c5b82dc1f441e92b834a21f2e29de/images/ad3d2c60086545648ce4f4caf1f99e6d%E1%84%89%E1%85%B3%E1%84%8F%E1%85%B3%E1%84%85%E1%85%B5%E1%86%AB%E1%84%89%E1%85%A3%E1%86%BA%202025-02-20%20%E1%84%8B%E1%85%A9%E1%84%92%E1%85%AE%209.11.15.png)

I want to emphasis Seamline using Normal map. ( 100 intensity, 3.0 thickness)  
But, i don't know how can compose normal map.  
please let me know solution or give me thickness 3 , intensity 100 normal map jpg. Thank you for reading.  


안녕하세요 현재 CLO 를 사용하고 있는 한국 유저입니다. 제가 심라인을 강조하기 위해서 Normal map 을 통해 intensity와 thickness을 조절하고싶은데 쉽지가 않습니다.

CLO에서 기본값으로 구성을 해야하는 상황이기에 manual하게 조정하는것 외에 normal map을 직접 기본 파일에 구성한뒤에 사용하고자 합니다.

혹시 해당 질문에 대한 normal map을 만드는 방법을 아시거나, jpg 업로드를 통한 도움을 주신다면 진심으로 감사하겠습니다.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: 안녕하세요! 우선, 첨부 해주신 이미지상에서 봤을 땐 노멀맵이미지가 아닌 검은색이미지가 사용 되고 있습니다. 따라서 노멀냅 jpg 파일을 사용 해주셔야 하는데, CLO 우측의 라이브러리 창에서 Hardware and Trims -> Seamline 경로로 들어가시면 CLO에서 기본 제공하는 Seamline normal map이 첨부되어 있습니다. 해당 이미지 파일들을 드래그 해서 Property Editor창의 3D seamline - Normal map에 드롭 해서 사용 해주시면 됩니다. 만약, Hardware and Trims -> Seamline 경로에 해당 노멀맵 이미지가 없다면 라이브러리 창 우상단 토글키 중 Download를 눌러주시면 해당 이미지가 다운로드 됩니다!
Reply 1: 안녕하세요! 답변해주셔서 진심으로 감사드립니다 혹시 제가 노말맵을 구성하는것에 대한 기본 지식이없어서 thickness와 intensity의값을 지정하는 노말맵을 만드는방법이 어떤건지 여쭤봐도 될까요?
Reply 2: 안녕하세요. 노말맵은 3D 그래픽에서 물체의 표면 디테일을 표현하는 데 사용 되는 특수한 텍스처 이며, 물체의 표면에 있는 질감의 표현을 실제 지오메트리(메쉬의 변형 등)를 편집하지 않고도 표현이 가능하게 해줍니다. 노말맵은 보통 푸른색 계열의 색상으로 이루어진 이미지 파일이며, 질감의 빛 반사 각도(음각, 양각, 옆면 등)에 따라 푸른색의 정도가 바뀌거나 빨강, 초록 등의 색상이 추가 됩니다. CLO에서 Seamline Normalmap의 Thickness 값은 노말맵 이미지 적용 후 Seamline의 너비를 늘려주는 기능이며, Intensity 값은 Seamline의 깊이 정도를 조절 해주는 기능이라고 생각주시면 좋을 것 같습니다. 먼저 드린 답변의 경로에서 Seamline에 대한 CLO의 기본 노멀맵을 확인 하실 수 있으며, CLO가 아닌 다른 이미지 편집툴을 통해 제작된 노말맵 또한 CLO로 가져와서 사용 하실 수 있습니다. 노멀맵은 다양한 이미지 편집툴을 이용해서 제작이 가능하며, 주로 포토샵 프로그램을 이용해서 제작 하는 것이 가장 일반적인 방법으로 알려져 있습니다. (Seamline normalmap의 경우는 CLO 기본 제공 이미지를 사용 하시는 것을 가장 추천 드립니다.)
Reply 3: 바쁘실텐데 성심성의껏 답변해주셔서 진심으로 감사드립니다! 좋은 주말 보내셔요 !! :)
content_description: This webpage provides guidance and resources for creating and customizing normal maps with specific intensity and thickness settings to emphasize seamlines in CLO garment designs.

title: Mahna Mahna now in CLO :😆
content:
Mahna Mahna doo doo doo doo… Mahna Mahna doo doo doo doo! 🎶

Sometimes, work gets so serious and intense that it feels like there’s no room for fun and creativity. But why? Why not use the same professional tools we work with every day to create moments of joy?

This project was a reminder to myself that fun can always be found, even in the most serious tasks! Using CLO 3D to bring this funny character to life was an amazing experience—proof that even the most professional software can be a playground for creativity and laughter. 😆

I hope this post brings a smile to your face and reminds you that even when work feels too serious, you can always add a bit of fun! 

How do you bring fun and creativity into your work?

#Creativity #FunAtWork #CLO3D #DigitalFashion #SeriousButFun
